name: Dungeon Picnic
description:
About This Game

Dungeon Picnic is a party-building roguelike RPG that distills everything great about RPGs into one package.

Even a single short run delivers the full thrill of an RPG.

Combine randomly appearing skills and equipment to build your own ultimate party and take down powerful enemies.

Party Building, Not Deck Building

Combine allies and equipment to unlock explosive combos.

Enjoy building your entire party as one.

Break the Limits, Turn Them Into Power

Skills have cooldowns, and the more powerful the move, the more carefully you need to manage it - but cooldowns aren't just a restriction.

Turn restrictions into strengths - like an ultimate move that costs every other skill's cooldown, or a skill that ignores cooldowns entirely.

Use all kinds of broken skills and break the limits.

Fast-Paced Turn-Based Battles Where Teamwork Is Key

There's no individual MP per character - instead, like a card game, your whole party shares a single "Mana" pool.

Break an enemy and you'll get an extra turn, increased mana recovery, and reduced mana costs.

Attack an enemy while it's broken and your critical hit rate goes up too.

Do you go all-in with a high-cost skill, or deliberately break the enemy with a support character to feed mana to your party?

Take control of your resources with flexible, on-the-fly strategy.

Also, mastering your allies' combo skills lets you unleash follow-up attacks and counters that ignore turn order entirely.

Mapless Dungeon Exploration

Dungeon exploration doesn't use a traditional map.

Instead of choosing a route, you can flexibly adapt your progress based on the situation.

Do you conserve your resources and rush for the boss, or take on risk to explore and reap the rewards?

Your judgment will be put to the test.

Roguelike game

When a party is defeated, you lose all your skills and equipment.

But since the skills and gear you find are randomized each time, you can enjoy the fun of creating a new party build every run.

-----

This game is under development. I may update the store page from time to time as development progresses.

If you are interested in this game, please add it to your wishlist!
short_desc: Dungeon Picnic is a fusion of RPG and roguelike - Enjoy only the best parts of an RPG. Combine allies and skills to build your own ultimate party. Pick 4 pixel-art heroines and dive into the dungeon!
